title: EFC — Master Specification (v1 Archive)
abstract: Canonical master specification for Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC), defining the formal structure, notation, and baseline equations for its three coupled base layers: EFC-S (structural/halo layer), EFC-D (energy-flow dynamics), and EFC-C0 (entropy–information capacity mapping). The paper establishes EFC as a thermodynamic information framework that replaces dark matter and dark energy with energy-flow potentials driven by density and entropy gradients.
